Delay1.reason: Probe artifact. x1 defaults to the input at control rate; the probe gives nanosynth's required source a UGen, while sclang's in defaults to 0.

Dibrown.reason: sclang's Dibrown inherits Dbrown's float defaults (hi 1, step 0.01); Dibrown_next truncates step to an integer, so sclang's default never moves. nanosynth keeps 12 and 1.

Dstutter.reason: sclang 3.14 redirects Dstutter to Ddup; the Dstutter plugin is still registered (DemandUGens.cpp).

Dwrand.reason: Probe artifact: sclang's probe passes a UGen as list, so its size is 0. The layout [repeats, size, weights..., list...] matches sclang.

FFT.reason: nanosynth defaults buffer_id to a LocalBuf; sclang requires a buffer.

LocalBuf.reason: nanosynth adds the MaxLocalBufs input at build time; the probe reads the graph before build.

MulAdd.reason: Optimizer UGen; sclang folds the constant probe away.

PV_ChainUGen.reason: Abstract base class of the PV UGens.

PV_HainsworthFoote.reason: sclang has ar only; the plugin fills any block size, so kr also works.

Sum3.reason: Optimizer UGen with no rate constructors; the graph optimizer creates it.
